notes.subject: moloko le moloko
notes.rationale: Hebrew לדר ודר is bound construct 'generation and generation'; Sepedi needs 'go … le …' to carry it

notes.subject: tumelo ya gago
notes.rationale: Hebrew is a verbless clause; no copula supplied, context carries it

notes.subject: tumelo
notes.rationale: אמונה is literally 'firmness/security' — could render 'botee' (steadfastness), chose 'tumelo' (faithfulness) per D2 register

translation: Go moloko le moloko tumelo ya gago; o tišitše ⟨את⟩ lefase, gomme ya ema.
